v1.24.2b (16 June 2024) |feed_title = 🔥 NEW SKINS 🔥 |previous_update = [[v1.23.0|The Classic Update]] |next_update = [[v1.25.0|Challenge Maps Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.24.0''' is the seventy-eighth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 7th of June 2024. It added five new skins and multiple fixes. This update encompassed four updates, the main '''v1.24.0''' update (23 May 2024) and three minor updates, v1.24.1 (released 11 June 2024), v1.24.2 (released 12 June 2024), v1.24.2a (released 15 June 2024) and v1.24.2b (released 16 June 2024). ==Additions== *New skins for the [[Premium Crate]]. **{{Color|Premium|Clown}} [[Jester]] **{{Color|Premium|Green}} [[Paintballer]] **{{Color|Premium|Steampunk}} [[Ranger]] *New skins for the [[Deluxe Crate]]. **{{Color|Deluxe|Classic}} [[Electroshocker]] **{{Color|Deluxe|Liberator}} [[Mercenary Base]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Refactored damage handling for towers. *{{RLinkC|11402072733|Dallas Mustache}} no longer gives a badge upon claiming it. *[[Coal Nametag]] no longer gives a badge upon getting its secret variant. *Fixed match cleanup after restarting. *Fixed issue stim from refactoring for damage handling. *Fixed [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode sometimes not giving any rewards. *Fixed [[Polluted Wasteland II]] giving the [[Badlands II]] badge, now it gives its own badge. *Fixed [[Necromancer]] breaking after trying to build gravestones while there is no path in range. *Fixed splash damage kills not counting for the [[Quests#Kill ENEMY!|Kill ENEMY!]] quest. *Fixed the upgrade screen on VR. :In '''v1.24.1''': *Fixed [[Premium Crate]], [[Deluxe Crate]] and [[Phantom Crate]] displaying incorrect cost in the inventory and [[Daily Store]], if the user has its gamepass prices decreased. :In '''v1.24.2a''': *[[Birthday]] modifier is now active on all maps. :In '''v1.24.2b''': *[[Birthday]] modifier is no longer active. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} June2024Thumbnail.png BRAWLERTOWERTHUMBNAIL.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} ClassicElectroshockerIcon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and things that are missing.'' ===v1.24.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|JuneSkinUpdateClean.png|🔥 NEW SKINS 🔥}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|🔥 New Skins}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.24UpdateLog1.png|Added Steampunk skin for [[Ranger]]}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.24UpdateLog2.png|Added Clown skin for [[Jester]]}} {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.24UpdateLog3.png|Added Liberator skin for [[Mercenary Base]]}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.24UpdateLog4.png|Added Classic for [[Electroshocker]]}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.24UpdateLog5.png|Added Green [[Paintballer]]?!?}} {{UpdateH3|🛠️ Bug Fixes & Internal Changes}} *Fixed [[VIP+]] rewarding *Fixed match restarting cleanup *Refactored damage handling with Towers *Fixed an issue where some towers weren't damaging *The issue stim from the refactoring for damage handling *Fixed upgrade screen for VR *Fixed leaderboards *Fixed an issue where [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] not awarding gems *Fixed [[Polluted Wasteland II|Polluted Wasteland]] badge }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.24.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
